mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, o.PURCHASE_CONFIRM_STATUS AS purchaseConfirmStatus, o.PURCHASE_CONFIRMED_AT AS purchaseConfirmedAt, o.RECIPIENT_NAME AS recipientName, o.RECIPIENT_PHONE AS recipientPhone, o.ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, o.ADDRESS1 AS address1, o.ADDRESS2 AS address2, NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') AS deliveryStatus, d.CARRIER_CODE AS carrierCode, d.COURIER_NAME AS courierName, d.WAYBILL_STATUS AS waybillStatus, d.WAYBILL_ASSIGNED_AT AS waybillAssignedAt, d.PICKED_UP_AT AS pickedUpAt, d.IN_TRANSIT_AT AS inTransitAt, d.TRACKING_NO AS trackingNo, d.DELIVERED_AT AS deliveredAt, p.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, p.PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, p.PAID_AT AS paidAt, p.PAID_AMOUNT AS paidAmount, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS discountAmount, o.DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFee, o.FINAL_AMOUNT AS finalAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}

SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, img.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, oi.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.SUBTOTAL AS subtotal, oi.MARKET_AVG_PRICE AS marketAvgPrice, oi.SAVED_AMOUNT AS savedAmount, oi.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, r.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo FROM OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN OFT_REVIEW r ON r.ORDER_ITEM_NO = oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND r.PRODUCT_NO = oi.PRODUCT_NO AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(IMAGE_NO) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(SORT_ORDER, 99999), IMAGE_NO ) AS IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) img ON img.PRODUCT_NO = oi.PRODUCT_NO WHERE oi.ORDER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT imageNo FROM ( SELECT img.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo FROM OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MIN(IMAGE_NO) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(SORT_ORDER, 99999), IMAGE_NO ) AS IMAGE_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) img ON img.PRODUCT_NO = oi.PRODUCT_NO WHERE oi.ORDER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID LIKE #{_parameter} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_ORDERS ( USER_NO, ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, TOTAL_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE, FINAL_AMOUNT, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2 ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{finalAmount}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address1}, #{address2} )

INSERT INTO OFT_ORDER_ITEM ( ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, QUANTITY, SUBTOTAL, MARKET_AVG_PRICE, SAVED_AMOUNT, SAVING_RATE ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{productNo}, #{productName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal}, #{marketAvgPrice}, #{savedAmount}, #{savingRate} )

INSERT INTO OFT_PAYMENT ( ORDER_NO, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_KEY, PAID_AMOUNT, PAID_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentKey}, #{paidAmount}, #{paidAt} )

INSERT INTO OFT_DELIVERY ( ORDER_NO, COURIER_NAME, TRACKING_NO, DELIVERY_STATUS, SHIPPED_AT, DELIVERED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{courierName}, #{trackingNo}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{shippedAt}, #{deliveredAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
UPDATE OFT_ORDERS SET CANCEL_STATUS = #{cancelStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
UPDATE OFT_ORDERS SET PURCHASE_CONFIRM_STATUS = #{purchaseConfirmStatus}, PURCHASE_CONFIRMED_AT = #{purchaseConfirmedAt}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_ORDER_CANCEL_REQUEST ( ORDER_NO, REQUESTED_BY_USER_NO, CANCEL_STATUS, REQUEST_REASON ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{requestedByUserNo}, #{cancelStatus}, #{requestReason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_ORDER_CANCEL_REQUEST SET CANCEL_STATUS = #{cancelStatus}, DECIDED_BY_USER_NO = #{decidedByUserNo}, DECISION_REASON = #{decisionReason}, DECIDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CANCEL_REQUEST_NO = ( SELECT cancelRequestNo FROM ( SELECT CANCEL_REQUEST_NO AS cancelRequestNo FROM OFT_ORDER_CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC, CANCEL_REQUEST_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )

UPDATE OFT_DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'IN_TRANSIT', TRACKING_NO = NVL(TRACKING_NO, #{trackingNo}), WAYBILL_STATUS = 'ASSIGNED', WAYBILL_ASSIGNED_AT = NVL(WAYBILL_ASSIGNED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP), IN_TRANSIT_AT = NVL(IN_TRANSIT_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP), SHIPPED_AT = NVL(SHIPPED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
UPDATE OFT_DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'DELIVERED', DELIVERED_AT = NVL(DELIVERED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{_parameter}

UPDATE OFT_PRODUCT SET STOCK_QTY = STOCK_QTY - #{quantity}, SALE_STATUS = CASE WHEN STOCK_QTY - #{quantity} <= 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE SALE_STATUS END WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND STOCK_QTY >= #{quantity}

UPDATE OFT_PRODUCT SET STOCK_QTY = STOCK_QTY + #{quantity}, SALE_STATUS = CASE WHEN SALE_STATUS = 'SOLD_OUT' AND STOCK_QTY + #{quantity} > 0 THEN 'SELLING' ELSE SALE_STATUS END WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
